VLC 3.0.24 plugin headers
https://github.com/videolan/vlc/tree/3.0.24/include

These unmodified headers are used only to compile Verc's subtitle layout
plugin. They are not included in the app bundle. See each header for its
copyright and license notice (LGPL 2.1 or later).

The plugin must be built against the bundled VLC 3.0.24 runtime.
